en.joke: My streaming subscription auto-renewed. I guess I'll spend another year scrolling through options.
en.explanation: This joke uses deadpan delivery to highlight the paradox of choice in modern streaming, where endless options often lead to inaction.

people.name: Jessica Mitford
people.extract: Jessica Lucy "Decca" Treuhaft was an English-American author, communist activist and one of the Mitford sisters. Her 1960 memoir Hons and Rebels and her 1963 book of social commentary The American Way of Death both became classics.
highlights: Author of classic memoir Hons and Rebels.
Wrote classic social commentary The American Way of Death.

people.name: Philipp Bouhler
people.extract: Philipp Bouhler was a German senior Nazi Party functionary who was both a Reichsleiter and Chief of the Chancellery of the Führer of the NSDAP. He was also the SS official responsible for the Aktion T4 euthanasia program that killed more than 250,000 disabled adults and children in Nazi Germany, as well as co-initiator of Aktion 14f13, also called Sonderbehandlung, that killed 15,000–20,000 concentration camp prisoners.
highlights: Senior Nazi Party functionary and Reichsleiter.
Chief of the Chancellery of the Führer.
Responsible for Aktion T4 euthanasia program.

people.name: James Allan (rugby union)
people.extract: James Allan ) was a New Zealand rugby union player who played eight games for the New Zealand national rugby union team, and was nicknamed the Taieri Giant. Allan played in the first match contested by the New Zealand team, and the New Zealand Rugby Union regard him as the first ever All Black.
highlights: New Zealand rugby union player, "Taieri Giant".
Played in New Zealand team's first match.
Regarded as the first ever All Black.
